mintAuthority.summary: wiTRY is Brix's yield-bearing staking wrapper over iTRY. At Ethereum block 26095937, the wrapper owner is contract 0x15bf1ac31c5b8c0e0960d656de02ba5593b19c47, whose owner is Brix Safe 0x7ac3bb10225a4ef27134bcf54454d545a1738662. The underlying iTRY owner remains Safe 0xbdb430adf64ff1c8201c10221ddb846fa62613b6. Both terminal Safes remain 3-of-5 with the same signer set. The wrapper's immediate owner is therefore not the Safe itself; issuer control remains concentrated through the intermediate contract.

controls.label: wiTRY wrapper controller owner (Brix Safe 3/5)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295016, wiTRY owner() returned Safe 0x7ac3bb10225a4ef27134bcf54454d545a1738662. At block 26095937 on 2026-10-01, wiTRY owner() instead returned contract 0x15bf1ac31c5b8c0e0960d656de02ba5593b19c47, whose owner() returned the same Brix Safe. Pinned Safe getOwners()/getThreshold() confirmed the recorded five signers and threshold 3; getModulesPaginated() returned an empty list with sentinel next pointer, the guard-manager slot was zero, VERSION() returned 1.4.1, and the fallback-handler slot returned 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99.

controls.label: iTRY underlying token owner (Brix Safe 3/5)
controls.evidence: Historical Ethereum block 25295016 identified iTRY owner Safe 0xbdb430adf64ff1c8201c10221ddb846fa62613b6 and its five signers with threshold 3. At block 26095937 on 2026-10-01, owner(), getOwners() and getThreshold() confirmed the same owner and signer set. getModulesPaginated() returned an empty list with sentinel next pointer, the guard-manager slot was zero, VERSION() returned 1.4.1, and the fallback-handler slot returned 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99. Both terminal Safes still share the same signer set.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295016: wiTRY wrapper owner and iTRY token owner are both Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 L2 multisigs (3/5, same 5 signers) confirming issuer-controlled architecture. MegaETH OFT adapter (0x15b271d9012b5820fc42b1c495b4c1e206547de5) owner could not be confirmed, MegaETH public RPCs returned errors, but the Ethereum primary chain is fully verified. MegaETH is a bridged deployment; the Ethereum Safe controls the canonical supply. Accountable independently reconciles the iTRY and wiTRY liabilities to backing assets. The public proof-of-solvency page advertises a 15-minute interval but showed reserve data last updated 2026-06-24, so the observed evidence supports periodic, not continuous, reconciliation. No registry evidence established prudential reserve supervision over wiTRY issuance. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: common Brix Safe signers control direct mint and upgrades, while dated Accountable assets-and-liabilities snapshots support periodic attestation-only oversight.
